xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5335: Workflow redesign F follow-up: collapse handoff groups, unclipped cost, footer label, one current nav item, keep last project, Feed tab polish

plan.title: Workflow redesign F follow-up: collapse handoff groups, unclipped cost, footer label, one current nav item, keep last project, Feed tab polish
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: PAN-5343 (child H, reuses lastProject.ts and ProjectMark.tsx)

metadata.sizeJustification: Nine small leaf fixes to one UI surface (the left column and the Feed tab). About half of the ~30 files_scope entries are the existing test files each fix must update, plus four doc files. The operator folded D-7 and D-8 into this issue by comment, and PAN-5343 lists this issue as one prerequisite unit that must merge whole before it is planned, so splitting into siblings would delay PAN-5343 without making any slice easier to review. No item shares a source file with another; the only shared file is scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt, which is merge=union.

narratives.Problem: The epic owner's live check of PAN-5293 (one left column) found six defects and the operator added two requests: handoff groups open by default and push Issues off screen; row cost is clipped mid-number; the footer reads 'Mac…'; Project home and More are both current on a conversation tab; a fresh load of /activity loses the project; the Feed tab repeats its title and offers Project scope without a project; the New conversation button does not say which model it uses; projects have no colored mark.
narratives.Proposal: Nine independent vertical slices, each a one-to-three-file change plus its tests, as specified in PRD .pan/drafts/pan-5335.md WI-1..WI-9: (1) groups default collapsed unless a descendant needs you, and a collapsed group still shows its selected row; (2) meta-line parts shrink with ellipsis and cost never shrinks; (3) footer Machines becomes icon-only; (4) Project home current only on the Home pane, Command Deck removed from More, More never current on Settings; (5) last project persisted in overdeck.ui.lastProjectKey via new lib/lastProject.ts and restored on fresh loads of non-deck routes; (6) Feed tab hides its inner header, widens, and hides/derives the Project scope without a project; (7) New conversation button's second line shows provider icon, short model, harness (non-Claude Code) and effort; (8) ProjectMark component with a stable 8-color palette on the switcher button and rows; (9) docs and changelog.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Project Home page content (child G, PAN-5294).
- The New conversation button's color; it stays non-primary.
- Redesigning successor chains to show the newest successor as the row or the '13 earlier sessions' wording; only the default collapse changes.
- Project marks on OtherMachineProjects rows, the breadcrumb, Stage tabs or split headers (PAN-5343 adds those).
- Removing any More item other than Command Deck, or removing Settings from More.
- Rewriting the stored overdeck.ui.awarenessScope preference when no project is selected.
- Validating a project that came from the URL route against the registry (the deck's UnknownProjectState already handles it).
- Changing the popstate handler's project rules in App.tsx.
- Any server, API route or contracts change.
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row.

autoDecisions.summary: D-1a: a collapsed group still renders its selected descendant, and only that one, under the toggle; selection does not open the group.
autoDecisions.rationale: A handoff chain's live successor is a descendant, so collapsing would hide the open conversation's own row. Opening the whole group on selection would show all 20 Flywheel successors again (defect 1), so only the selected row is shown.

autoDecisions.summary: D-4: More is never current when activeTab is 'settings'; the footer Settings button carries the current state there.
autoDecisions.rationale: FR-4 says at most one nav item is current. Settings is listed in More and also has the always-visible footer button, which already sets aria-current. Excluding it from moreActive is the smallest change and keeps Settings reachable from More.

autoDecisions.summary: D-4: Project home reads the deck's active pane with usePanesStore(selectActivePane(selectedProject ?? '')); a null pane counts as Home.
autoDecisions.rationale: CommandDeck/index.tsx line 346 passes deckKey={selectedProject} to Stage and Breadcrumb.tsx line 20 already uses the same lookup with a Home fallback, so the two agree.

autoDecisions.summary: D-5: the stored last project is restored on every initial route except a route that names a project, the bare /command-deck path, and /conv/... paths.
autoDecisions.rationale: The PRD keeps bare /command-deck as 'no project'; conversation deep links set their own project through the deck's deep-link effect, so leaving them at today's null start avoids a regression in that flow.

autoDecisions.summary: D-5: only a storage-derived value is validated, once, after the registered-projects query reports isSuccess; NO_PROJECT_KEY and key-or-name matches are valid.
autoDecisions.rationale: The query's [] default and the project-created flow would otherwise clear a valid selection; selectedProjectKey can hold either a key or a name (resolveDeckKey returns rp.name ?? rp.key).

autoDecisions.summary: D-6: with no project the Project scope chip is hidden and the effective scope is derived as Global without writing storage.
autoDecisions.rationale: Writing 'global' would overwrite the operator's preference; deriving restores Project as soon as a project is selected. projectScopeAvailable={scoped} covers both null and NO_PROJECT_KEY.

autoDecisions.summary: D-7: the effort word is omitted when the model takes no effort, using the same levels rule useCreateConversation.ts lines 42-43 uses; the provider icon is omitted when the provider is unknown and uses the group label (not the model label) as its letter-badge label.
autoDecisions.rationale: The line must name exactly what quick create sends. ProviderLogo renders a letter badge from its label for unbranded providers, so it needs the provider name.

autoDecisions.summary: D-8: keep the PRD hash ((sum of char codes) * 31 % 8) and pin test values from the real project keys.
autoDecisions.rationale: On the 21 keys in .overdeck/projects.yaml it spreads 4,1,2,3,2,3,3,3, no worse than FNV-1a (3,3,1,3,3,3,3,2); collisions are unavoidable with 8 colors, so changing the PRD decision buys nothing.

autoDecisions.summary: WI-5 is tested with pure helpers in lib/lastProject.ts plus App.test.tsx cases that read selectedProjectKey through a changed ActivityPanel mock.
autoDecisions.rationale: App.test.tsx mocks LeftColumn and ActivityPanel, so the PRD's original 'Conversations section renders' assertion cannot be written there; the ActivityPanel mock is the observable seam.

autoDecisions.summary: D-5: when validation rejects a stored project key, the key is also removed from storage (clearLastProjectKey).
autoDecisions.rationale: Otherwise every reload would briefly show the dead project, and PAN-5343's readLastProjectKey() would keep returning it.

autoDecisions.summary: D-7: the button calls useAvailableModels() on every route; the catalog loads once per page through the shared module promise.
autoDecisions.rationale: The requests run after mount, are shared with every other picker, and are not on the pre-mount boot list (lib/bootRequests.ts); FALLBACK_GROUPS covers the common models until they resolve.
